## README.md
# TreeMap

![aboveground](https://img.shields.io/badge/aboveground-blue) ![biomass](https://img.shields.io/badge/biomass-blue) ![carbon](https://img.shields.io/badge/carbon-blue) ![conus](https://img.shields.io/badge/conus-blue) ![conterminous United States](https://img.shields.io/badge/conterminous_United_States-blue) ![forest](https://img.shields.io/badge/forest-blue) ![forest inventory](https://img.shields.io/badge/forest_inventory-blue) ![forest type](https://img.shields.io/badge/forest_type-blue) ![gtac](https://img.shields.io/badge/gtac-blue) ![landcover](https://img.shields.io/badge/landcover-blue) ![landfire](https://img.shields.io/badge/landfire-blue) ![TreeMap](https://img.shields.io/badge/TreeMap-blue)

TreeMap 2023 provides 30-meter forest attribute rasters for the conterminous United States. This Source Cooperative publication contains the 2023 release only. The publication includes 22 single-band attribute GeoTIFFs, one TM_ID raster, a 2023 Raster Attribute Table in CSV and Parquet, and a collection- level attribute data dictionary CSV. Published raster attributes are ALSTK, BALIVE, CANOPYPCT, CARBON_D, CARBON_DWN, CARBON_L, DRYBIO_D, DRYBIO_L, FLDSZCD, FLDTYPCD, FORTYPCD, GSSTK, QMD, SDIsum, STANDHT, STDSZCD, TM_ID, TPA_DEAD, TPA_LIVE, VOLBFNET_L, VOLCFNET_D, and VOLCFNET_L. Asset-level STAC metadata includes per-attribute titles, units, and definitions. The TreeMap2020_CONUS_DataDictionary.csv asset provides the full field-level dictionary and FIA source notes.

## Coverage

- West: -128.9772, South: 22.7686, East: -65.2545, North: 51.6497

**Temporal Extent**

- 2023-01-01 to 2023-12-31

## Source

[https://data.fs.usda.gov/geodata/rastergateway/treemap/](https://data.fs.usda.gov/geodata/rastergateway/treemap/)

## Processing Notes

The source is the GTAC separated-attribute raster delivery. The published assets in this repository come from 2023_Production_rerun_final_zone_imputations. The ingest checks each TIFF for COG compliance, copies compliant COGs unchanged, and converts failed checks locally with GDAL. It validates each output before writing to the dedicated network COG delivery. The source was inventoried on 2026-10-06. The 2023 Raster Attribute Table is copied unchanged from the GTAC reference- data delivery. A Parquet derivative supports direct remote queries. The dictionary CSV is a normalized export of the source workbook reviewed on 2026-02-25. Attribute metadata is published in the STAC item asset metadata (`title`, `description`, and `raster:bands` fields) and in both 2023 RAT assets.
